findings.description: The interpreter output does not capture the "Bank ID#" field and the "Copies of this Bank" numeric input required for EC condenser configuration.
The interpreter omits the "Default Condenser" and "High Amb. / Altit. Cond." checkboxes from the AC condenser requirements, leaving their intended behavior undocumented.

No validation rules or range specifications for numeric inputs (Design Ambient, ASHRAE Summer Design, Wet Bulb Temperature, Copies of this Bank) are included, contrary to the need for input validation.
The interpreter does not mention per‑circuit cooling configuration inputs, which are referenced in the ticket as necessary for accurate ECS calculations.
